title: The Shape of a Program: Path Signatures for Trace-to-Program Induction
abstract: arXiv:2611.13005v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthesizing programs from execution traces is a fundamental challenge in algorithmic interpretability and the reverse engineering of complex systems. We bring a rough-path-theoretic perspective to program induction, treating execution traces as high-dimensional rough paths and encoding them with the path signature transform, a tool from stochastic analysis whose expectation provably characterizes the distribution of traces a program induces. On three program-induction domains, Karel, List, and RASP, our log-signature trace encoder outperforms LSTM, Transformer, and Fourier baselines in almost every setting, with its largest margins when training data is scarce. We further observe that the trace-to-program pipeline is naturally contractive: it often produces valid programs that are shorter than the ground truth. translated_title: 程序的形态：用于轨迹到程序归纳的路径签名
translated_abstract: 从执行轨迹中合成程序是算法可解释性与复杂系统逆向工程中的一项根本性挑战。我们将粗路径理论的视角引入程序归纳，把执行轨迹视为高维粗路径，并用路径签名变换对其进行编码——这是来自随机分析的一种工具，其期望可被证明能够刻画程序所诱导的轨迹分布。在 Karel、List 和 RASP 三个程序归纳领域上，我们的对数签名轨迹编码器几乎在所有设置下都优于 LSTM、Transformer 和傅里叶基线，且在训练数据稀缺时优势最为显著。我们进一步观察到，轨迹到程序的流程天然具有收缩性：它往往能生成比真实程序更短的合法程序。我们将这一特性转化为一种自举方法，无需任何外部预言机即可揭示真实监督信号中存在的冗余。
tldr: 本文将粗路径理论引入程序归纳，用路径签名变换编码执行轨迹，在 Karel、List 和 RASP 三个领域几乎全面超越 LSTM、Transformer 和傅里叶基线（尤其在数据稀缺时优势最大），并利用流程天然的收缩性构建无需外部预言机的自举方法来揭示监督数据的冗余。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces rough path theory to program induction by encoding execution traces with the path signature transform, outperforming LSTM, Transformer, and Fourier baselines on Karel, List, and RASP—especially under scarce training data—and leverages the pipeline's natural contractiveness to bootstrap the discovery of redundancy in ground-truth supervision without any external oracle.
